시편-128-1.title: 시편 128장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-128-1.exegesis: 3-5. Posterity is often represented as a blessing from God ( Ge 30:2 , 18 ; 1Sa 1:19 , 20 ). Children are represented as the defenders (arrows) of their parents in war, and in litigation.
시편-128-1.theologicalNote: 3-5. Posterity is often represented as a blessing from God ( Ge 30:2 , 18 ; 1Sa 1:19 , 20 ). Children are represented as the defenders (arrows) of their parents in war, and in litigation.

시편-128-2.title: 시편 128장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-128-2.exegesis: PSALM 128 Psa 128:1-6 . The temporal blessings of true piety. The eighth chapter of Zecariah is a virtual commentary on this Psalm. Compare Psa 128:3 with Zec 8:5 ; and Psa 128:2 with Le 26:16 ; De 28:33 ; Zec 8:10 ; and Psa 128:6 with Zec 8:4 . 1. (Compare Psa 1:1 ).
시편-128-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 128 Psa 128:1-6 . The temporal blessings of true piety. The eighth chapter of Zecariah is a virtual commentary on this Psalm. Compare Psa 128:3 with Zec 8:5 ; and Psa 128:2 with Le 26:16 ; De 28:33 ; Zec 8:10 ; and Psa 128:6 with Zec 8:4 . 1. (Compare Psa 1:1 ).

시편-128-3.title: 시편 128장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-128-3.exegesis: 2. For thou shalt eat-- that is, It is a blessing to live on the fruits of one's own industry.
시편-128-3.theologicalNote: 2. For thou shalt eat-- that is, It is a blessing to live on the fruits of one's own industry.
